Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer - Data Infrastructure
jobs.description:
**Senior Software Engineer - Data Infrastructure, Mobility Simulation and Planning**  
  
**About the role and team**  
  
How can Uber plan pricing and incentives to meet financial goals while keeping its marketplace healthy and growing? That’s the challenge our Mobility Simulation and Planning (MSP) organization tackles within Marketplace.  
  
MSP builds forecasting, simulation, and optimization products that help Operations teams translate financial targets into pricing and incentive policies across hundreds of cities. Our planning product, Planner, brings these capabilities together to generate actionable price plans. Supporting this work requires dependable data, scalable model training and simulation, and reliable workflows for generating and deploying plans.  
  
The **MSP Infra team** builds the data and computing foundations that make these capabilities possible. We partner with engineers and scientists to turn complex data and modeling workflows into reliable, scalable, reusable infrastructure.  
  
We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer with a strong infrastructure background and a focus on data-intensive systems. You’ll build and evolve feature stores, distributed data pipelines, and self-service tooling that support forecasting, simulation, optimization, and financial measurement. Your work will help teams move from new data and modeling ideas to dependable production workflows.  
  
The challenges go beyond moving data from one place to another. How do we keep model inputs fresh and consistent as upstream sources evolve? How do we efficiently rebuild historical features for simulation and backtesting? How do we make complex data operations safe and self-service? You’ll solve these problems through hands-on engineering, cross-team collaboration, and end-to-end ownership of production systems.  
  
**What you’ll do**  

* **Build scalable data infrastructure:** Design and evolve shared feature stores and distributed processing pipelines that support model training, inference, backtesting, simulation, and planning.
* **Make data trustworthy:** Develop automated validation, monitoring, and alerting to detect freshness, completeness, and correctness issues before they affect downstream consumers.
* **Improve data lifecycle operations:** Build efficient capabilities for incremental processing, historical backfills, schema evolution, data versioning, and recovery from failed or incorrect writes.
* **Enable self-service:** Create reusable frameworks, APIs, and developer tooling that help engineers and scientists onboard features, investigate issues, and operate workflows with less manual support.
* **Optimize performance and cost:** Identify bottlenecks in data processing, storage, and orchestration, and improve throughput, resource efficiency, and reliability.
* **Drive technical projects end to end:** Translate ambiguous requirements into designs, lead implementation and rollout, and own production health through on-call, incident response, and long-term improvements.
* **Collaborate and mentor:** Partner with modeling, financial-data, and shared-platform teams to establish consistent data foundations; guide engineers through thoughtful design reviews, code reviews, and technical mentorship.

  
**Basic Qualifications**  

* 6+ years of professional experience in software engineering, data infrastructure, or a related technical role.
* Strong programming skills in Python, Java, Scala, Go, or a comparable language.
* Experience designing, building, and operating large-scale data pipelines or distributed data-processing systems.
* Strong SQL skills and experience with data modeling, storage systems, and query-performance optimization.
* Experience delivering technical projects from design through production rollout and ongoing operations.
* Ability to communicate technical tradeoffs and collaborate across engineering and data science teams.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Experience with Apache Spark or comparable distributed data-processing frameworks.
* Experience with Apache Hudi or similar data lake technologies supporting incremental updates, schema evolution, and versioned datasets.
* Experience building feature stores or data infrastructure for machine learning, forecasting, optimization, or simulation.
* Experience developing reusable data-quality frameworks, observability systems, or tools for tracing and reconciling data across sources.
* Familiarity with workflow orchestration and distributed computing frameworks such as Ray.
* Experience building self-service platforms or automation that reduces operational overhead for engineers and scientists.
* A track record of measurable improvements in data reliability, processing performance, infrastructure cost, or developer productivity.

  
For New York City, NY-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $202,000 per year - USD $224,000 per year.  
  
For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $202,000 per year - USD $224,000 per year.

jobs.title: Sr. AI Perception Engineer
jobs.description:
### **About Anyware Robotics**

Anyware Robotics builds general-purpose mobile manipulator robots for industrial applications. Our robots are trusted by customers across logistics, retail, and manufacturing, supporting applications such as truck unloading, mobile palletizing, and machine tending.

### **Description**

About Anyware

Anyware Robotics builds general-purpose mobile manipulator robots for industrial applications. Our robots are trusted by customers across logistics, retail, and manufacturing, supporting applications such as truck unloading, mobile palletizing, and machine tending.

The Role

The robots run on **AnywareOS**, our industrial physical intelligence system. Its architecture is modular and designed to generalize across applications without reprogramming. We are seeking a **Sr. AI Perception Engineer** to advance Anyware's production 3D AI perception stack for warehouse automation robots, with a focus on object localization, pose estimation, scene reconstruction, and deployment on robot compute within application cycle-time constraints.

This role is for an engineer who builds AI perception that works on real sensor data and physical systems — not only on benchmarks — and who wants to take it through production and real-world operation. You will own perception capabilities end to end within your area — problem definition, model and pipeline development, deployment on robot hardware, monitoring, failure analysis, and production improvement — and make pragmatic tradeoffs across accuracy, reliability, latency, compute, data, maintainability, engineering effort, and delivery timelines.

This is a hands-on senior individual-contributor role. You will own the design decisions in your area, contribute to architecture and design reviews, and work closely with the Perception Team Lead and Staff engineers who set technical direction across the perception stack.

What you'll do

* **Build 3D AI perception on physical systems, hands-on** — develop robust object localization, pose estimation, and scene reconstruction models and pipelines using RGB-D and other sensing modalities, running on robot compute within application cycle-time constraints.
* **Own perception capabilities end to end** — from problem definition and prototyping through deployment, monitoring, failure analysis, and production improvement within Anyware's existing perception stack.
* **Improve perception reliability on physical robots** — diagnose and fix failures caused by difficult scenes, changing lighting, sensor noise, and gaps between training data and customer environments.
* **Strengthen production readiness** — better data, evaluation, regression testing, release criteria, observability, and systematic root-cause analysis of field failures.
* **Make pragmatic engineering tradeoffs across the robot system** — balance accuracy, robustness, latency, compute cost, data availability, maintainability, and delivery timelines while integrating perception reliably with planning, manipulation, controls, and system software.

Required Skills

* BS, MS or PhD in Robotics, Computer Vision, Computer Science, or a related field.
* **3+** years of professional experience developing **AI perception systems** for physical robots or comparable real-world machines.
* **Hands-on proficiency building AI perception models** (PyTorch or similar) and real-time perception pipelines in Python and C++.

Nice to have

* Experience deploying and operating AI perception in production on physical robots — running models under latency and compute constraints on robot hardware and owning reliability in the field.
* Strong foundation in 3D geometry, camera models and calibration, RGB-D or point-cloud processing, and 3D object localization, segmentation, or pose estimation.
* Experience with ROS or ROS2 for real-time robotic perception pipelines, including sensor-data processing and model integration.
* Experience deploying robotic perception systems in warehouse, logistics, or other industrial environments.

Why Anyware

* **An A+ Team:** Anyware is built by top talents. Collectively, our team has won six Best Paper Awards and Finalists, including the ICRA 2025 Best Paper Award and ICRA 2024 Best Paper Award.
* **An A+ Robot:** Our robot, Pixmo, won the Best Innovation Award (top-1) at both ProMat 2025 and MODEX 2026 — the two largest logistics automation exhibitions in the world. Pixmo also won the RBR50 Robotics Innovation Award.
* **Real Impact:** Your perception work does not stop at a demo. It ships into real customer sites, directly affects robot reliability and throughput, and must perform under real-world variation.
* **Fast Growth:** You will have strong ownership and real responsibility in a growing robotics company.
* **Generous Equity:** We offer generous equity in addition to salary and benefits.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is 150K-240K USD/year, depending on experience and qualifications.

Additional compensation may include equity, benefits, or other incentives, where applicable.

Benefits & Perks

* Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family
* Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Paid sick leave
* 401(k) plan support
* Daily meal credit

Equal Opportunity Statement

Anyware is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume and any relevant materials through the **Anyware Career platform**. We look forward to learning more about your experience and interest in joining our team.

#### **Salary**

$150,000 - $240,000 per year

jobs.title: E11 Bio - Machine Learning Scientist I/II
jobs.description:
E11 Bio is on a mission to advance connectomics towards the scale of whole mammalian brains. We are a collaborative and interdisciplinary team of scientists and engineers engaged in a neuroscience moonshot project to develop a radical technology platform for scalable brain mapping. E11 Bio is a non-profit Convergent Research focused research organization located in Alameda, California, pursuing blue-skies neuroscience research yet operating like a nimble, tight-knit start-up. Read our technology roadmap.

We are seeking a creative and mission-driven Machine Learning Scientist to develop scalable automatic proofreading methods leveraging barcode and shape information. In this role, you will own core ML pipelines for automated proofreading of neuron and synaptic reconstructions in optical connectomics datasets, working closely with wet lab scientists, microscopists, and domain experts to ensure biological fidelity and scalability. Your work will directly support E11’s goal of making reliable connectomic data accessible to the broader neuroscience community.

In this role you will be focused on decreasing segmentation and proofreading costs for optical connectomics datasets that we are generating at E11, a critical bottleneck in the connectomics field. You will be responsible for improving initial segmentations using large spatial contexts with rich data features, and ingesting resulting datasets into scalable proofreading software for dissemination to the scientific community.

### **Responsibilities**

* Contribute to developing innovative ML approaches for automatic proofreading of segmentations in large PB-scale optical connectomics volumes, leveraging shape and barcode information
* Own the deployment of scalable workflows to ingest large connectomic datasets into standard proofreading software (WebKnossos, CAVE)
* Collaborate with academic and industry experts on building and extending tools for automated proofreading and interactive visualization
* Develop, implement, and evaluate scalable pipelines for synapse detection and partner assignment in large-scale optical connectomics datasets, integrating morphological and protein labeling information

DoorDash's ML Serving Platform delivers **tens of millions of predictions per second**, powering search, recommendations, advertising, delivery estimates, and logistics across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo.

Our customers are modelers and engineering teams across our internal business verticals. We build self-serve infrastructure that empowers them to bring new models into production, adopt open source software and models, and expand what they can accomplish with machine learning at scale.

We work at the intersection of a rapidly evolving open source ecosystem and demanding production workloads. With active customer demand and growing modeling ambitions, we're advancing the infrastructure behind today's predictions while building the capabilities that enable the next generation of ML innovation.

You'll help build the next generation of our ML serving platform, connecting request routing and online feature retrieval with model inference on CPU and GPU infrastructure. Working alongside experienced platform engineers, you'll own defined projects from technical design and implementation through testing, rollout, and production support. You'll partner directly with internal teams to understand emerging modeling requirements, remove adoption barriers, and turn advances in open source technology into measurable production improvements.

* **Improve Kubernetes deployment and autoscaling.** Help workloads respond to changing traffic while meeting latency and availability requirements and using CPU and GPU resources efficiently.

**Company:**
------------

Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.

**Job Area:**
-------------

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Machine Learning Researcher

**General Summary:**

Qualcomm AI Research is seeking world-class researchers to help push the boundaries of artificial intelligence and machine learning. Our team pioneers new algorithms, models, and systems that advance the state of the art while delivering exceptional performance with unprecedented power, memory, and computational efficiency.

  

Our multidisciplinary team brings together expertise across algorithms, software, hardware, and systems. We pursue fundamental and applied research, from foundational theories and novel learning algorithms to efficient AI systems deployed on resource-constrained devices. Working closely with Qualcomm's business and engineering teams, we translate research breakthroughs into technologies deployed worldwide across mobile, compute, automotive, robotics, cloud, XR, and IoT platforms, while publishing at leading AI conferences.

  

Our team has demonstrated world-first research breakthroughs and proof-of-concepts across model efficiency, representation learning, perception and understanding, generative and foundation models, reasoning and agentic intelligence, and embodied and physical AI. Our research contributions have earned numerous best paper awards, major research competition wins, and top rankings on AI and computer vision benchmarks. We also translate these breakthroughs into highly optimized AI models, end-to-end workflows, and developer tools for Qualcomm platforms, making many innovations accessible to all. Explore our research and innovations:

* Research Breakthroughs and Demonstrations
* Qualcomm AI Research Publications and Innovations
Qualcomm AI Hub: Optimized Models and Workflows  

  

**Role Responsibilities:**

Research interns will contribute to fundamental and applied research in artificial intelligence and machine learning, developing novel algorithms, models, and systems that advance the state of the art. Research opportunities span a broad range of areas, including:

* **Generative AI and Foundation Models:** Large language models (LLMs), multimodal foundation models, vision-language models (VLMs), vision-language-action models (VLAs), world models, and generative modeling for language, image, video, audio, and 3D content. Research topics include diffusion and autoregressive models, mixture-of-experts, parallel decoding, long-context modeling, and knowledge distillation.
* **Agentic AI and Reasoning:** Autonomous agents, multi-agent systems, reasoning, planning, and verification; memory management, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), inference-time optimization, robustness, alignment, AI safety, and hallucination mitigation.
* **Efficient and Scalable AI:** Novel neural architectures, efficient attention mechanisms, transformers, state-space models, and recurrent networks; model compression, pruning, quantization, neural architecture search, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, and efficient training and inference. A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.  
  
Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide.

  

**The Opportunity**

Within AI for Drug Discovery, the Frontier Research team advances fundamental machine learning and statistics methods, motivated by real-world challenges in drug discovery. In biology and medicine, many important problems cannot yet be addressed with off-the-shelf machine learning approaches—they demand not only novel solutions, but also new paradigms for framing and thinking about the problems themselves. Instead of focusing on incremental improvements, we work on long-horizon ideas that require a creative and broad perspective, developing solutions at a level that can be instantiated for multiple internal and external applications. jobs.title: Applied Scientist, Superconducting Digital and Cryogenic Control Electronics,Center for Quantum Computing, Physical Design and Simulation, Enabling Technologies
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Amazon Center for Quantum Computing (CQC) is seeking an Applied Scientist to research and design cryogenic control hardware for large-scale quantum processors, with an emphasis on superconducting digital circuits. Controlling and reading out orders of magnitude more qubits than today's systems demands rethinking where classical control lives and what technology implements it; you will design and model superconducting digital logic (e.g., single-flux-quantum-family circuits) and related cryogenic electronics, evaluate them against the wiring, power, and thermal budgets of a scaled system, and co-design control approaches with the qubit devices they serve. You will carry designs from concept through simulation, layout, design review, and fabrication handoff, and your evaluations will inform which control-electronics directions the organization invests in.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and simulate superconducting digital circuits and cryogenic control/readout electronics for scalable qubit control
* Develop and validate Josephson-junction circuit models, timing and margin analyses, and verification methodology for superconducting digital designs
* Quantify system-level trade-offs — wiring count, power dissipation at each cryogenic stage, latency, footprint — across candidate control architectures, and communicate recommendations
* Co-design control interfaces with qubit-device colleagues so control electronics and quantum devices are developed as one system
* Deliver design artifacts through the organization's design-request and design-review processes, including tapeout-ready layouts and verification reports
* Present results internally and, where appropriate, publish in peer-reviewed venues

  
About the team  
The Enabling Technologies team develops technologies and relationships facilitating scaling, including alternative quantum processor architectures, superconducting qubit device packaging, and cryogenic control device electronics. We work alongside a co-located quantum processor design team focused on current-generation devices; the two teams share design and review processes, and moving ideas between them is an explicit part of our charter.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of building models for business application experience
* Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
* Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
* Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, a Master's degree or above in a relevant field
* Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
* Experience with circuit design and simulation
* Familiarity with superconducting qubit control and readout — pulse generation, multiplexed readout, feedback latency requirements
* Experience designing superconducting digital circuits (RSFQ/ERSFQ, adiabatic quantum phase parametron, or related single-flux-quantum logic families), including Josephson-junction circuit simulation and margin analysis
* Experience with EDA flows for custom circuit design — schematic capture, layout, physical verification, and working against a process design kit

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience using Unix/Linux
* Experience in professional software development
* Knowledge of cryogenic electronics more broadly: cryo-CMOS, low-temperature amplifiers and mixers, thermal and power budgeting across refrigerator stages
* Experience with microwave engineering and signal integrity in dense cryogenic interconnect
* Experience taking chips through fabrication and correlating measured circuit behavior with design models
* Familiarity with quantum error correction decoding and the classical-processing requirements it places on control systems

**Job Description**

**The Role**

We’re AV Frameworks within AV Platform Core at General Motors. We build the foundational frameworks that power robotics and autonomous capabilities across distributed compute — with a focus on inter-process communication (IPC), middleware, and developer experience that make complex systems reliable, observable, and fast. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design and deliver the core communication and runtime building blocks used by AV/Robotics applications on vehicles, on benches, and in simulation. You’ll work across C++ systems, Linux, and networking/IPC to achieve low-latency messaging, deterministic scheduling, and production-grade reliability at scale.

  

**What you’ll do**

* Own design and implementation of high-performance IPC and middleware primitives (publish/subscribe, shared memory, serialization, discovery, QoS).

* Drive latency, throughput, and determinism improvements through profiling, tracing, benchmarking, and targeted optimizations.

* Build developer-facing APIs, tooling, and documentation that improve ergonomics, correctness, and velocity for internal customers.

* Deliver platform-ready components with observability (metrics, logs, traces), robust fault handling, and reproducible performance characteristics.

* Collaborate cross-functionally with platform OS, drivers, safety, controls, perception, and tooling teams to integrate end-to-end solutions.

* Apply production rigor: code reviews, testing strategies (unit, integration, soak), performance and regression gates, and rollout/rollback discipline.

Mentor engineers, contribute to design reviews, and raise the bar on engineering excellence.  

  

**Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)**

* BS/MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.

* 7+ years building systems-level software in modern C++ (C++17/20/23) or Rust on Linux.

* Deep knowledge of concurrency, memory management, lock-free or low-contention patterns, and performance profiling.

* Hands-on experience with IPC/messaging systems and distributed systems fundamentals (serialization, backpressure, flow control, QoS).

* Strong understanding of networking (sockets, TCP/UDP, multicast, NICs, buffers, MTU, packetization) and time synchronization concepts.

Proficiency with build and CI tooling (Bazel/Buck/CMake, test frameworks, artifact/versioning strategies).  

  

**What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Robotics/AV middleware: ROS 2, DDS, gRPC, ZeroMQ, eCAL, shared memory IPC.

* Advanced networking/IO: io\_uring, RDMA/PCIe messaging, kernel/bpf-based observability, packet capture and analysis.

* Safety and reliability awareness (diagnostics, failover, degraded modes, basics of ISO 26262 considerations for software components).

Secondary languages and tooling: Python/Go for tooling/integration

**Senior Software Engineer - ML Infrastructure, Mobility Simulation and Planning**  
  
**About the role and team**  
  
How can Uber plan pricing and incentives to meet financial goals while keeping its marketplace healthy and growing? That’s the challenge our Mobility Simulation and Planning (MSP) organization tackles within Marketplace.  
  
MSP builds forecasting, simulation, and optimization products that help Operations teams translate financial targets into pricing and incentive policies across hundreds of cities. Our planning product, Planner, brings these capabilities together to generate actionable price plans. Supporting this work requires scalable model training and simulation, efficient distributed computing, and reliable workflows for generating and deploying plans.  
  
The **MSP Infra team** builds the data and computing foundations that make these capabilities possible. We partner with engineers, scientists, and shared-platform teams to turn complex modeling workflows into reliable, scalable, reusable infrastructure.  
  
We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer focused on ML infrastructure. You’ll build the frameworks, distributed execution capabilities, and developer tooling that help scientists develop, train, evaluate, and productionize models. Your work will make it easier to move from an experimental model to a dependable production workflow and to run the simulations and backtests needed to evaluate marketplace decisions.  
  
How do we scale training and simulation across CPUs and GPUs? How do we make experiments reproducible and performance bottlenecks easy to diagnose? How do we support new modeling approaches without creating a separate infrastructure stack for every use case? You’ll solve these problems through hands-on engineering, close collaboration with modeling teams, and end-to-end ownership of production systems.  
  
**What you’ll do**  

* **Build shared ML frameworks:** Design and evolve reusable interfaces and libraries for model development, training, inference, evaluation, and backtesting.
* **Scale distributed workloads:** Build and optimize execution capabilities for training, simulation, and optimization across CPU and GPU infrastructure.
* **Accelerate experimentation:** Develop tooling for hyperparameter tuning, experiment tracking, reproducibility, and performance analysis so scientists can evaluate ideas faster.
* **Simplify productionization:** Create reliable orchestration, configuration, dependency management, and deployment patterns that reduce the gap between experimentation and production.
* **Improve performance and efficiency:** Profile workloads, diagnose compute and memory bottlenecks, and make thoughtful tradeoffs across runtime, resource utilization, reliability, and cost.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

Contribute to the org-wide shift from product-specific search solutions to a composable, agent-native infrastructure foundation that agents and applications build on to locate, search, discover, and recommend resources across heterogeneous enterprise data.

* Build and own the infrastructural substrate beneath the agentic search platform, spanning the index engine, the ingestion and enrichment pipeline, and the entity, identity, and feature intelligence that gives content context. Solve the hard problem of keeping index-time enrichments aligned with what agents expect at query time, so retrieval, ranking, and reasoning all build on a consistent foundation.
* Build and operate hybrid indexing technology at scale across large clusters, spanning keyword-based sparse-vector indices, embedding-based semantic indices, and emerging semantic-ID indexing driven by next-token prediction. Own the full index lifecycle, and expose clean, unified contracts to the search primitives and recipes that agents compose on top of the corpus.
* Design and run high-throughput ingestion and enrichment pipelines that produce a multi-representation, permission-aware corpus at index time. Orchestrate the stages that make content agent-ready, including parsing, chunking, embedding, entity resolution, and access control, and evolve them as new agentic use cases emerge.
* Build and operate multi-modal indexing across the full mix of enterprise data, from free text and structured content such as tables to diagrams, images, and audio and video. Represent each modality so it is retrievable through a unified surface, letting agents find the right material regardless of its form or source.
* Contribute to a knowledge graph that resolves entities across enterprise data sources, letting agents link disparate resources such as tickets, files, and people through canonical entity relationships.
* Improve the performance, scalability, and observability of search, including query latency, indexing throughput, and cluster health, to deliver low-latency, high-quality agentic search experiences. Apply techniques such as vector quantization to balance model quality, retrieval performance, and storage cost.
* Own search infrastructure end to end, from intake and design through rollout and ongoing operations, and help shape the search roadmap as the platform grows to support new agents, primitives, and recipes, including needs not yet anticipated.
* Drive reliability and operability across the platform through index lifecycle policies, capacity planning, and cluster scaling strategies that keep a growing library of reusable search capabilities healthy in production.

This is a highly collaborative, in-person role, working cross-functionally with Search Ranking, ML, and Platform engineering teams to deliver robust, production-grade agentic search capabilities.

* BS or MS in Computer Science or an equivalent engineering background; PhD is a plus.
* 2+ years of full-time industry experience.
* Hands-on experience with search technologies; proficiency in one or more search technologies such as Lucene, Solr, Elasticsearch, or OpenSearch is required, with additional experience in vector databases being an advantage.
* Excited to be part of an in-person team culture, collaborating on-site with colleagues every day.

**Job Description**

General Motors is a global leader in advanced driver assistance. With Super Cruise hands-free technology in more than 500,000 Super Cruise–equipped vehicles on the road and over 700 million hands-free miles driven, GM is proving that automation can be trusted, intuitive, and helpful. GM has the global reach to bring cutting-edge advances to everyday drivers at unprecedented scale. Join us to help deliver the next generation of safe and delightful personal autonomous vehicle experiences.

  

**About the Team**

Every autonomous-driving engineer at GM eventually asks the same questions: *What happened on that drive? Where else has this happened? Why did the vehicle do that? Did my change fix it?* The AV Analysis team builds the tools that answer them, across the full life of AV data:

* Record and catalog new data as it comes in from the fleet, so engineers know what exists, where it came from, and whether it's ready to use.
* Index and mine road data alongside simulation output, so engineers can find the scenes that matter using structured filters, similarity search, and natural-language queries.
Analyze what happened by replaying sensor data, perception output, and planner decisions in synchronized 3D, camera, plot, and map views. Engineers do this to triage and diagnose an issue, or to validate a new change.  

  

Perception, planning, simulation, mapping, validation, and data teams use these tools every day. That work spans next-generation autonomous development vehicles, Super Cruise programs, and autonomous mobile robots in GM factories. We're part of AV Tooling, which also builds GM's fleet-operations tools and AI-assisted triage. * Index and mine road data alongside simulation output. Build search that combines structured metadata queries in SQL with embedding-based similarity search in vector databases, plus natural-language queries and LLM- and VLM-powered curation.
* Build high-performance tools for analyzing what happened, with synchronized replay of camera video, lidar, 3D scenes, plots, and maps. Engineers use them to triage and diagnose issues, to validate new software changes, and to debug live in the vehicle during testing.
* Take ambiguous requests from idea to shipped. Write requirements and design docs that weigh options, build consensus with stakeholders, and deliver iteratively so users are unblocked early.
* Serve as technical lead for a multi-project workstream. Plan and break down the work, delegate, hold a high bar in design and code reviews, and guide engineers across GM who contribute to our tools.
* Keep tools fast and reliable in production, and raise the bar for the team's engineering systems: tests, CI speed, developer experience, observability, and on-call.
Mentor engineers, and use AI-assisted development and agentic workflows to multiply what a small team can deliver.  

  

**Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)**

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3+ years building complex, data-intensive web applications with TypeScript/JavaScript and React.
* A track record of spotting an unmet user need yourself, building the tool or feature that addressed it, and driving it to real adoption.

* Comfort working across the stack, designing APIs and building services in Node.js or Python.
* Deep experience diagnosing and fixing web application performance problems (rendering, memory, large-data and streaming throughput) through profiling and measurement.
* Demonstrated technical leadership: leading multi-person projects, writing design docs, and driving decisions across teams.
* Clear written and verbal communication with technical users whose needs differ widely, from perception researchers to test operators.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.  

  

**What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Depth in search and retrieval: multimodal embeddings (e.g., CLIP- or SigLIP-style image–text models), hybrid ranking that blends vector similarity with structured filters, and measuring search relevance.
* Building LLM-, VLM-, or agent-based features into products, and fluency with AI-assisted development tools.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Autonomy Evaluation & Metrics Platform
jobs.description:
Rivian’s Autonomy Eval Infrastructure team builds the software that helps engineers understand  
and improve the ML models behind our driving systems and gives release teams evidence they  
can trust. Within Autonomy’s AI Platform organization, we connect model development with  
evaluation workflows, metrics, triage and visualization across simulation and real-world vehicle  
data.

As a senior metrics-platform engineer, you will design, build and operate a substantial part of  
the platform that makes autonomy evaluation consistent and reproducible. Working directly with  
Perception, Planning and Systems engineers, you will connect model experiments to reliable  
metrics and help turn insights about model behavior, failure modes and generalization into  
improvements in models and data.  
This is a hands-on software engineering role. You will own projects through design,  
implementation, rollout and operation, make practical system-design trade-offs, and mentor  
teammates. As an early member of a newly formed team, you will help establish the engineering  
practices and interfaces that make the platform useful across Autonomy.

  

* Own the design and delivery of a metrics-platform area, such as the metric registry,  
  computation services or comparison and reporting APIs, in partnership with the team’s  
  technical lead.
* Design versioned metric definitions and data models for inputs, aggregation, slicing and  
  results. Preserve provenance linking official evaluation runs to code, model, dataset and  
  scenario versions.
* Build distributed computation and storage paths with idempotent execution, incremental  
  processing and controlled backfills. Make informed trade-offs across throughput, latency,  
  cost and reproducibility.
* Build comparison tools that expose coverage, sample sizes, uncertainty and changes in  
  evaluation inputs. Help users distinguish model regressions from data, simulator or  
  infrastructure failures.
* Partner with model developers to design evaluation experiments, inspect predictions and  
  analyze failure patterns. Use the findings to guide model and data improvements, and  
  build reusable evaluation harnesses that shorten the iteration cycle.
* Integrate metrics and regression checks into replay and closed-loop evaluation  
  workflows and CI. Partner with domain owners on metric semantics and thresholds, and  
  with Systems on evidence for release decisions.
* Deliver self-service APIs and scorecards backed by consistent definitions and results.  
  Migrate existing consumers incrementally while preserving reporting continuity and  
  traceability.
* Own reliability and performance for your services through testing, observability, incident  
  investigation and operational documentation; measure improvements in turnaround time,  
  correctness and cost.
* Write and review production code, lead design reviews for your projects, mentor  
  engineers, and collaborate across Palo Alto, London and Belgrade to deliver software  
  that users adopt.

  

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated  
  experience and impact, including ownership of production backend or data-intensive  
  systems.
* Hands-on experience building software for autonomy or robotics, with direct exposure to  
  evaluation, simulation, perception, planning or validation workflows.
* Strong Python programming skills, with the ability to write, test, profile and debug  
  maintainable production software.
* Practical SQL skills, with AI coding tools expected to support writing and refining  
  queries; ability to validate query logic, results and performance.
* Demonstrated system-design ability across service APIs, data modeling, distributed  
  processing and storage, including failure recovery, consistency and performance  
  trade-offs.
* Experience taking a project from requirements and design through implementation,  
  rollout and operation, coordinating dependencies and communicating trade-offs clearly.
* Practical understanding of model inference and evaluation, including held-out datasets,  
  generalization, reproducibility and model versioning, and the differences between  
  open-loop replay, closed-loop simulation and real-world measurements.
* Ability to reason about sampling, confidence intervals, noisy metrics and valid  
  comparisons, and to work with domain experts when stronger statistical analysis is  
  needed.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD and production observability,  
  plus a track record of constructive code review and mentoring.  
  Bonus Points
* Experience building metric registries, evaluation services, experiment-tracking systems  
  or automated regression gates used by multiple engineering teams.
* Experience with Spark, Databricks, Delta Lake or comparable distributed data systems,  
  and with AWS, Docker or GitLab CI.
* Experience migrating analytical or reporting systems without breaking downstream  
  consumers, or linking metrics to scenario-level debugging and triage.
* Experience with PyTorch or similar ML frameworks, evaluation of end-to-end driving  
  models, or connecting offline model metrics to closed-loop and real-world driving  
  behavior.

* **Frontier access. Anthropic Preferred Partner:** newest Claude models, real budgets, real problems.
* **Real tasks (not scope), real deployment.** You go where the operating problem is and ship production code to real users, not slide decks that sit in a drive.

* **Autonomous**. You own the work from framing through to production, visible to clients and founders. You own the method; nobody hands you a ticket.

* Be part of the customer’s team, inside their process; work on real tasks, not scoped deliverables, and own the method autonomously
* You won’t start from zero. Provectus builds industry Blueprints, working systems that have already shipped for a customer in your industry. Your engagement starts from that baseline, and what you learn in the field goes back into it
* Deliver across Cowork Activation, Agentic SDLC, and Blueprint Activations in Financial Services and Healthcare
* Help shape how leading enterprises adopt AI, from strategy through first deployment; help build the tooling and frameworks of a growing AI delivery practice

### **What we look for:**

* Typically 7+ years building software, a substantial share of it writing production code you were accountable for. You are hands on today and intend to stay that way
* Genuinely willing to spend time understanding someone else’s job before writing code; demonstrated ability to become conversant in an unfamiliar business function quickly
* Shipped GenAI/LLM systems to production, not demos, not notebooks. You’ve handled the parts that get hard after the prototype works
* You evaluate. You have built or owned an eval suite for a nondeterministic system, and you can explain what you measured and why
* Strong engineering fundamentals. Dropped into an unfamiliar codebase or language, you’re productive. Python and/or TypeScript proficiency; depth matters more than stack
* Cloud native delivery on AWS (GCP/Azure a plus), including the operational reality of a system someone else inherits
* Presales experience. Credible with senior stakeholders: you can hold a redesign conversation with a BU head and a scoping conversation with a CTO without losing either room
* Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. Engagements start underspecified by design. Closing that gap is the job
* Hands on experience with Claude, Claude Code, and Cowork (skills, workflows, MCP, integrations, connectors, custom harnesses)

**Nice to have:**

* Containers and orchestration (Kubernetes/ECS) and CI/CD in production

* Open source contributions or public writing on applied AI

### **What We Offer:**

* Full time
* On site visits to client’s facilities and our office in NYC once a week
* Unlimited Vacation policy
* Generous health, vision, and dental insurance
* 401(k) matching plan
* Base salary $180k to $250k + bonuses; OTE up to $300k. The salary range is determined through interviews and a review of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, and alignment with market data
* No Visa sponsorship

### **We’re real:**

* A person reads your application. We filter out AI generated and fraudulent submissions automatically. Every application that clears that filter is read by someone on our team
* We may ask for a quick ID verification. Fraudulent applications are common, and this protects real candidates
* You’ll meet the people you’d work with. We host AI engineering events in New York and San Francisco. We’d be happy to talk in person. Your interviews are with Pavel Borobov, Solutions Architect, and Stepan Pushkarev, Cofounder & CEO

### **How we hire:**

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
**Region:** North America, all regions

### **The Role**

SDVI’s DevOps team keeps customer environments provisioned, up to date, and running. Those environments process content for television and streaming services around the world. The team works with the rest of Engineering to design, build, launch, and maintain whole-system deployments.

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you’ll be a primary owner of major parts of our infrastructure and drive projects with minimal direction. You’ll be responsible for the infrastructure that television and streaming services depend on every day, at a company small enough that your decisions are visible and impactful. When production issues happen, you’ll take the lead through resolution, root cause analysis, and follow-up work.

### **What You’ll Work On**

* Own major parts of a growing fleet of over 10,000 cloud compute instances serving dozens of customer environments
* Configure and provision the other AWS building blocks that support running Rally environments
* Drive the design and expansion of deployment automation for a growing set of customer environments
* Monitor the health and security of SDVI infrastructure, and work with Engineering to decide when new monitoring and alerting tools are worth building, then build and maintain them
* Automate creation of Windows and Linux AMIs so third-party tools can scale quickly
* Build and maintain tools that let other developers make infrastructure changes themselves
* Lead production incident response, keep all stakeholders informed, and lead root cause analysis, including defining and assigning follow-up work
* Manage the cost of deployed Rally infrastructure, and look for ways to make it more efficient
* Improve the practices and tools the team uses
* Take part in a paid after-hours on-call rotation with the Support Engineering and DevOps teams

### **What Success Looks Like**

* **First 90 days.** You’ve shipped infrastructure changes to production, know how our customer environments are deployed end to end, have joined the on-call rotation, and are driving at least one project.
* **First year.** You’re a primary owner of a major part of our deployment or monitoring infrastructure, you’ve led root cause analysis on production incidents, and you’ve made a measurable improvement to reliability or cost.

### **What You’ll Bring**

* Extensive experience owning production systems, and an understanding of the responsibility that comes with access to them
* Strong Python and bash skills, and the ability to read code in most other languages
* Deep experience building and maintaining infrastructure on a mainstream cloud platform, such as AWS, GCP, or Azure
* Experience supporting SaaS platforms, microservice-based systems, and containerized software
* Comfort configuring both Linux and Windows server environments
* Enough SQL to find your way around a database console and write basic queries
* Experience leading incident response and root cause analysis
* Curiosity about new infrastructure, tools, and technologies, and the discipline to learn them in depth
* The ability to explain deeply technical topics to non-technical audiences, and to adjust how you communicate for customers, management, or peers

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience with AWS specifically
* Experience with PowerShell
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools
* Familiarity with professional media formats and tools, such as codecs, container formats, and media encoders

If you don’t meet every point above, we’d still like to hear from you.

### **How We Work**

* **We’re small and distributed.** Most of our collaboration happens over Slack and Zoom, across time zones. You’ll own what you build, and you’ll work closely with people outside your immediate team.
* **Engineers stay close to customers.** You’ll hear directly from the people using what you build. When something goes wrong in production, the team that owns the code helps fix it.
* **We dig for root causes.** When something breaks, we find out why instead of patching the symptom and moving on.
* **We ship, then refine.** We work in short sprints and improve things over time instead of waiting for a perfect first version.

### **How We Use AI**

AI coding agents are part of how we work every day, and we invest in getting good at using them. We’re also careful with them, because customers run their content operations on Rally. We’re tracking industry trends and innovations, but using our day-to-day experiences to separate signal from noise.

Our engineers are still responsible for the code they ship. We still expect them to explain and defend its architecture and intent, even as more is built with an agent’s help. We judge work by its quality, not its quantity.

This role is not a fit for someone who would rather not use AI tools, or who is used to shipping generated changes they couldn’t explain. It probably is a fit for someone who knows where these tools go wrong and how to achieve quality with speed.

### **Logistics**

* This is a remote role. You should be based in the United States, and either in the Eastern time zone or able to commit to working East Coast hours
* This role includes a paid after-hours on-call rotation
* Occasional travel may be required, but is not core to this role
* Interview process: introductory call, AI proficiency interview, team technical interview, interview project, interview project presentation, and founders interview

### **Compensation and Benefits**

*Salary range $140,000 to $185,000*

*Salary range represents the expected range for this position and is based on a number of factors, including location, and* *will* *vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges are US-applicable only.*

### **You Should Be Interested in SDVI Because:**

* You are looking for your next big challenge
* You are looking for a company that welcomes your talent virtually
* You want teammates you can learn from, and who will learn from you

**Company Description**

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Contribute to the org-wide shift from product-specific search solutions to a composable, agent-native infrastructure foundation that agents and applications build on to locate, search, discover, and recommend resources across heterogeneous enterprise data.

  

* Build and own the infrastructural substrate beneath the agentic search platform, spanning the index engine, the ingestion and enrichment pipeline, and the entity, identity, and feature intelligence that gives content context. Solve the hard problem of keeping index-time enrichments aligned with what agents expect at query time, so retrieval, ranking, and reasoning all build on a consistent foundation.
* Build and operate hybrid indexing technology at scale across large clusters, spanning keyword-based sparse-vector indices, embedding-based semantic indices, and emerging semantic-ID indexing driven by next-token prediction. Own the full index lifecycle, and expose clean, unified contracts to the search primitives and recipes that agents compose on top of the corpus.

Orchestrate the stages that make content agent-ready, including parsing, chunking, embedding, entity resolution, and access control, and evolve them as new agentic use cases emerge.

**Senior Software Engineer - Data Infrastructure, Mobility Simulation and Planning**  
  
**About the role and team**  
  
How can Uber plan pricing and incentives to meet financial goals while keeping its marketplace healthy and growing? That’s the challenge our Mobility Simulation and Planning (MSP) organization tackles within Marketplace.  
  
MSP builds forecasting, simulation, and optimization products that help Operations teams translate financial targets into pricing and incentive policies across hundreds of cities. Our planning product, Planner, brings these capabilities together to generate actionable price plans. Supporting this work requires dependable data, scalable model training and simulation, and reliable workflows for generating and deploying plans.  
  
The **MSP Infra team** builds the data and computing foundations that make these capabilities possible. We partner with engineers and scientists to turn complex data and modeling workflows into reliable, scalable, reusable infrastructure.  
  
We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer with a strong infrastructure background and a focus on data-intensive systems. You’ll build and evolve feature stores, distributed data pipelines, and self-service tooling that support forecasting, simulation, optimization, and financial measurement. Your work will help teams move from new data and modeling ideas to dependable production workflows.  
  
The challenges go beyond moving data from one place to another. How do we keep model inputs fresh and consistent as upstream sources evolve? How do we efficiently rebuild historical features for simulation and backtesting? How do we make complex data operations safe and self-service? You’ll solve these problems through hands-on engineering, cross-team collaboration, and end-to-end ownership of production systems.  
  
**What you’ll do**  

* **Build scalable data infrastructure:** Design and evolve shared feature stores and distributed processing pipelines that support model training, inference, backtesting, simulation, and planning.
* **Make data trustworthy:** Develop automated validation, monitoring, and alerting to detect freshness, completeness, and correctness issues before they affect downstream consumers.
* **Improve data lifecycle operations:** Build efficient capabilities for incremental processing, historical backfills, schema evolution, data versioning, and recovery from failed or incorrect writes.
* **Enable self-service:** Create reusable frameworks, APIs, and developer tooling that help engineers and scientists onboard features, investigate issues, and operate workflows with less manual support.
* **Optimize performance and cost:** Identify bottlenecks in data processing, storage, and orchestration, and improve throughput, resource efficiency, and reliability.
* **Drive technical projects end to end:** Translate ambiguous requirements into designs, lead implementation and rollout, and own production health through on-call, incident response, and long-term improvements.
* **Collaborate and mentor:** Partner with modeling, financial-data, and shared-platform teams to establish consistent data foundations; guide engineers through thoughtful design reviews, code reviews, and technical mentorship.

  
**Basic Qualifications**  

* 6+ years of professional experience in software engineering, data infrastructure, or a related technical role.
* Strong programming skills in Python, Java, Scala, Go, or a comparable language.
* Experience designing, building, and operating large-scale data pipelines or distributed data-processing systems.
* Strong SQL skills and experience with data modeling, storage systems, and query-performance optimization.
* Experience delivering technical projects from design through production rollout and ongoing operations.
* Ability to communicate technical tradeoffs and collaborate across engineering and data science teams.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Experience with Apache Spark or comparable distributed data-processing frameworks.
* Experience with Apache Hudi or similar data lake technologies supporting incremental updates, schema evolution, and versioned datasets.
* Experience building feature stores or data infrastructure for machine learning, forecasting, optimization, or simulation.
* Experience developing reusable data-quality frameworks, observability systems, or tools for tracing and reconciling data across sources.
* Familiarity with workflow orchestration and distributed computing frameworks such as Ray.
* Experience building self-service platforms or automation that reduces operational overhead for engineers and scientists.
* A track record of measurable improvements in data reliability, processing performance, infrastructure cost, or developer productivity.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Sponsored Products and Brands (SPB) helps millions of advertisers reach shoppers across Amazon's stores worldwide. Behind every ad we show are machine learning models that predict click-through rate (CTR) and conversion rate (CVR). These predictions decide which ads are relevant, how they rank, and how advertisers get value.  
  
Our team builds and runs the ML infrastructure behind those models, end to end:  
  

* Offline feature engineering: a multi-tenant platform used by several ML teams. It runs thousands of daily feature jobs over petabyte-scale data and produces the features that train models in every marketplace we serve.
* Model training: the standard system that retrains CTR and CVR models every day. How fresh these models are directly affects advertiser results and Amazon's revenue.
* Online feature store and feature retrieval: low-latency, high-throughput services that provide features when a model makes a prediction. These predictions feed the scores used in real-time ad ranking.
* Next-generation research platform: a platform that uses AI agents to help scientists explore, test and launch new model ideas faster.

  
As an SDE II, you'll design, build and run distributed systems that work at very large scale, both in offline batch processing and online serving. You'll work closely with applied scientists and engineers to make models fresher, help scientists try ideas faster, and keep the systems that support ads ranking reliable.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and develop ML infrastructure for advanced recommendation models, from training through real-time inference, that delivers highly relevant ads to shoppers worldwide
* Improve the scalability, automation and efficiency of large-scale training and real-time inference systems
* Work closely with applied scientists to optimize the performance of ML models and infrastructure, and take models from experimentation into production
* Deliver ML solutions end to end: design, implementation, testing, deployment and operations
* Collaborate with engineers and scientists across the team to build systems that serve ads across all Amazon platforms and surfaces
* Participate in design and code reviews and mentor peers

  
A day in the life  
You might start the day checking the health of the overnight feature and training pipelines. Then you'd work with scientists on how to support a new model architecture, and spend the afternoon building a performance improvement for the online feature store. You'll ship often, see your work affect ads served around the world, and influence how ML infrastructure grows across the organization.

The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re-imagining the advertising landscape through industry leading generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising.
  
  
We're the team behind the full ML lifecycle for Sponsored Products recommendation models, from raw data to features, training and real-time serving. We value ownership, getting things done, and close collaboration with science partners. We invest in mentorship and in tools that make engineers and scientists more productive, including AI-assisted development.

* 3+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
* 3+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
* 1+ years of building large-scale machine-learning infrastructure for online recommendation, ads ranking, personalization or search experience

* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description:
Government technology has failed citizens, veterans, public servants, and service members for decades.

Kaizen powers America’s application layer. We replace the legacy systems federal agencies run on with modern software, built with craft. The ticketing platform a resident uses to visit a presidential library. The marketplace DoW uses to procure counter-drone systems to protect lives and critical infrastructure. The system a Veteran uses to access benefits. We build systems of record, of national consequence. Our AI-native modules and harness allow us to do so in weeks, not years.

This year, our revenue has grown 35x. Next year, our software will serve over 100 million Americans across dozens of federal agencies.

Founded in 2022 and based in New York City and DC, Kaizen has raised $35 million from NEA, a16z, Accel, 776, and Carpenter Capital.

**Location**

New York, NY (Hybrid). In office Monday to Thursday. Candidates must live in or be able to commute to New York City.

**The Role**

Most companies building with AI connect someone else's models to their software. Kaizen's AI-native platform turns requirements into working applications, and today much of that intelligence comes from general-purpose models that carry capabilities we don't need, lack knowledge we do, and leave us and our customers paying frontier-model token costs for intelligence we don't control. This role changes that. You'll fine-tune, adapt and distill open-weight models into specialized intelligence Kaizen owns, and prove where it beats the general-purpose alternative. The goal isn't the biggest model or the most papers: it's public-sector software that works better, costs less to run, and is harder to replicate.

**What You'll Do**

* Fine-tune, adapt and distill open-weight models for requirements interpretation, code generation, repository understanding, structured output and software validation.
* Own the experiment loop: curate datasets, build training pipelines, and test architectures and techniques until a promising idea becomes a working model.
* Build evaluations on real software engineering tasks that set baselines, expose failure modes, and separate real gains from benchmark noise.
* Work with platform engineers to find where current models fall short, then build the capabilities that close those gaps and ship them into production.
* Experiment with supervised fine-tuning, synthetic data, preference optimization and reinforcement learning to improve model behavior on specialized tasks.
* Deliver applications built around each customer's needs without frontier-model token spend, so public budgets go to residents, not inference.
* Lay the groundwork (datasets, evals, research practices) for Kaizen to eventually train its own models from scratch.

**What You'll Bring**

* Hands-on experience training, fine-tuning or adapting language models. You've worked with model weights, not just model APIs or prompts.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals. You build reliable training pipelines, debug complex systems, and write code other engineers build on.
* Strong Python and PyTorch, with a working understanding of transformer architectures, tokenization and language model training.
* Something you've built that shows real model engineering ability: a fine-tuned model, an original training approach, or a meaningful open-source ML contribution. Industry, research or independent work all count; demonstrated ability matters more than years or credentials.

**Strong Candidates May Also...**

* Have fine-tuned models for code generation, program synthesis or repository understanding.
* Design experiments and evaluation sets that tell a meaningful improvement from noise or overfitting.
* Bring experience with synthetic data, distillation, quantization, or preference optimization and RL with verifiable rewards.
* Have contributed to open-source model development, published applied ML research, or reproduced significant research results.

**Don't Apply If...**

* Your model experience is prompt engineering and API calls.
* You'd rather publish a result than ship a model people use every day.
* You hand off notebooks and expect someone else to make them run in production.
* You assume the biggest model is the right answer and don't want to think about cost.

Residents and public servants rely on the software we build because they don't have another option. The models underneath it have to earn that.

**What Kaizen Offers**
----------------------

**Health & Insurance**

* 100% coverage across the board: medical through Oxford/United (Gold and Platinum PPO plans), dental through Guardian PPO, and vision through Beam — all fully covered for employees, with 100% coverage for dependents.
* $100,000 in fully paid life insurance. FSA and Dependent Care FSA.
* One Medical membership, on us — same-day primary care, 24/7 virtual visits, and offices all over the city.
* Fertility and family-building support through Carrot.
* 401(k) through Guideline, with a 2% company match.

**Family & Time Off**

* 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for birthing parents. 10 weeks fully paid for non-birthing parents.
* Unlimited PTO, with a two-week minimum (we mean it when we say take time off!)
* Closed for all federal holidays.
* Company-wide winter break the week of Christmas.
* Company offsites throughout the year.

**Office & Remote Setup**

* Up to $750 one-time home office or desk setup stipend for NYC-based employees. $500 for remote employees.
* $50/month commuter benefit (company contribution).
* Expensed lunch while in the office.
* Dinner and Uber rides home will be expensed if you choose to work in the office past 7pm.
* Company-provided laptop of your choice.

**Wellness**

* NYC employees: Fully covered gym membership at Grindhouse — right across the street from our office at 47 W 17th St (and in Williamsburg). A $225/month value, on us.
* Non-NYC employees: $100 per month, dedicated to gym / physical fitness reimbursement.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About the Company**

Dirac is building the creative suite for manufacturing engineering. Manufacturing engineering has been underserved by fractured tooling. The work of defining how a product gets built is spread across process plans, MBOMs, routings, work instructions, spreadsheets, PLM configurations, ERP tables, and internal tools. Each artifact represents only part of the process, forcing engineers to rebuild context whenever a design changes.

BuildOS brings these workflows together in one environment. Manufacturing engineers author, version, review, and distribute the Build—the canonical definition of how a product is produced.

**About the Role**

Our customers build aircraft, spacecraft, defense systems, ships, energy equipment, and heavy machinery. You'll own features end to end, from the services underneath to the tools manufacturing engineers use every day. The work spans backend, frontend, and 3D, and most of it starts with a real customer problem.

We want engineers who take a problem from vague to shipped, find the root cause before the fix, and use AI tools well while owning the result.

**What You'll Work On**

Depending on your strengths, you might work on:

* Turning CAD models into structured, versioned manufacturing data
* An authoring experience manufacturing engineers live in all day
* Interactive 3D in the browser for assemblies with thousands of parts
* AI that drafts work instructions and helps engineers plan a build
* Integrations with the enterprise systems manufacturers already run
* Secure deployments for aerospace and defense customers

**Our Stack**

Go, TypeScript and React, Rust and WebAssembly, Python and C++, on AWS and Azure. You don't need experience with all of it.

**Requirements**

* Strong in Go or TypeScript, and willing to work in the other; able to read Rust, Python, or C++ when a bug leads there
* Experience building backend services with typed APIs (protobuf/gRPC or similar) on top of a relational database
* Experience building non-trivial React frontends with real state management
* You debug from evidence: logs, a reproduction, and the root cause before the fix
* You check your own work in the running app, not just in passing tests
* You use AI coding agents every day and review their output as hard as a colleague's
* Clear, concise writing in design notes, PR descriptions, and tickets
* You've built something, at work or not, and can explain it in conversation

**Nice to Have**

* CAD, 3D graphics, or computational geometry
* Rust, WebAssembly, or GPU programming
* Integrations with enterprise systems such as PLM, ERP, or MES
* Shipping LLM-based features to production
* Cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes
* Security or compliance work in regulated industries
* A background in manufacturing, aerospace, or defense

**How We Work**

* **Own it end to end.** You take work from the first customer conversation to proof that it works in the product.
* **Learn the user.** You'll work with the manufacturing engineers who use what you build, and sometimes spend time on their factory floors.
* **High trust, high agency.** If something needs doing, you do it.
* **AI-native.** We build with AI tools every day and hold their output to the same bar as our own.
* **Fix it once.** When we catch a mistake, we fix it and make sure it can't happen again.

Base: $120,000 - $200,000 + Equity

**Location**

Fully in person at our NYC office in the Empire State Building (350 5th Ave). Relocation assistance is available.

$120,000 - $200,000 USD

Employment is restricted to **U.S. Persons** as defined by **ITAR (22 CFR § 120.62)**

**Benefits:**

* Health, Dental, Vision Insurance: Comprehensive coverage to ensure you and your family stay healthy.
* Generous Paid Time Off: Enjoy flexible, high-trust PTO and sick leave.

jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer - ML Infrastructure
jobs.description:
**Senior Software Engineer - ML Infrastructure, Mobility Simulation and Planning**  
  
**About the role and team**  
  
How can Uber plan pricing and incentives to meet financial goals while keeping its marketplace healthy and growing? That’s the challenge our Mobility Simulation and Planning (MSP) organization tackles within Marketplace.  
  
MSP builds forecasting, simulation, and optimization products that help Operations teams translate financial targets into pricing and incentive policies across hundreds of cities. Our planning product, Planner, brings these capabilities together to generate actionable price plans. Supporting this work requires scalable model training and simulation, efficient distributed computing, and reliable workflows for generating and deploying plans.  
  
The **MSP Infra team** builds the data and computing foundations that make these capabilities possible. We partner with engineers, scientists, and shared-platform teams to turn complex modeling workflows into reliable, scalable, reusable infrastructure.  
  
We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer focused on ML infrastructure. You’ll build the frameworks, distributed execution capabilities, and developer tooling that help scientists develop, train, evaluate, and productionize models. Your work will make it easier to move from an experimental model to a dependable production workflow and to run the simulations and backtests needed to evaluate marketplace decisions.  
  
How do we scale training and simulation across CPUs and GPUs? How do we make experiments reproducible and performance bottlenecks easy to diagnose? How do we support new modeling approaches without creating a separate infrastructure stack for every use case? You’ll solve these problems through hands-on engineering, close collaboration with modeling teams, and end-to-end ownership of production systems.  
  
**What you’ll do**  

* **Build shared ML frameworks:** Design and evolve reusable interfaces and libraries for model development, training, inference, evaluation, and backtesting.
* **Scale distributed workloads:** Build and optimize execution capabilities for training, simulation, and optimization across CPU and GPU infrastructure.
* **Accelerate experimentation:** Develop tooling for hyperparameter tuning, experiment tracking, reproducibility, and performance analysis so scientists can evaluate ideas faster.
* **Simplify productionization:** Create reliable orchestration, configuration, dependency management, and deployment patterns that reduce the gap between experimentation and production.
* **Improve performance and efficiency:** Profile workloads, diagnose compute and memory bottlenecks, and make thoughtful tradeoffs across runtime, resource utilization, reliability, and cost.
* **Build on shared platforms:** Partner with Uber’s ML and compute platform teams to adopt and extend common capabilities rather than maintain isolated infrastructure.
* **Own systems and raise the engineering bar:** Lead projects from design through rollout and operations, participate in on-call and incident response, and mentor engineers through design and code reviews.

  
**Basic Qualifications**

DreamLever / MilesAI Inc. New York City preferred (Hybrid)

**About DreamLever**
--------------------

DreamLever is the AI a company shares. It learns the business through meeting conversations, connects what's happening across people, teams, and goals, and uses AI agents to move work forward.

Founded by Brandon Katz, a former Chief of Staff who helped scale a company from 35 to more than 250 people, DreamLever turns firsthand experience building and running a company's management system into software. The product is live with paying customers, including a company with roughly 145 weekly active users across departments. Our external engineering partner, Scope Labs, helped build the product and continues to contribute, providing engineering support and knowledge of the existing system as we build our in-house team.

**The Role**
------------

As a Software Engineer at DreamLever, you'll join our small in-house engineering team and help build and ship a live, customer-facing product. You'll write code every day, take features from idea to release, and grow quickly with hands-on support from DreamLever's founding engineer and founder.

You'll collaborate closely with the founding team: the founder who leads the product vision and prototypes in detail, and the founding engineer who sets the technical direction. Expect regular working sessions, code reviews, and pairing, plus room to take real ownership of features as you ramp up.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Ship product improvements.** Build across the full stack, using coding agents effectively to move faster and ship well-tested code regularly.
* **Turn product direction into working software.** Take direction, prototypes, and feedback from the founder and founding engineer through implementation and polish, and confirm the finished experience does what customers need.
* **Collaborate with the founding team.** Work side by side with the founder and founding engineer on planning, technical decisions, and code review, and bring your own ideas to the table.
* **Learn the existing system.** Get to know the architecture, integrations, and data flows well enough to build confidently on a live codebase.
* **Help improve Miles's AI quality.** Support work on how Miles, DreamLever's AI Chief of Staff agent, uses company context and takes action: evaluate its outputs, investigate failures, and iterate on reliability.
* **Keep the codebase healthy.** Fix bugs, add tests, and keep code and documentation clear so the team can move faster and safer.

**Who You Are**

* **A builder who ships.** You love writing software, use coding agents fluently, and take responsibility for the quality of your work.
* **A fast learner.** You get oriented in unfamiliar codebases, ask focused questions, and turn direction into working software without needing every step spelled out.
